definition: to burst out suddenly after being held in
description: In a traditional Chinese garden pavilion, a young woman in a lilac satin wrap top and cream trousers suddenly bursts out laughing, covers her mouth with her hand, laughs harder with her head thrown back and finally bends over wiping her eyes. Behind her a young man in a black traditional jacket kneels very seriously at a low rosewood table, pouring tea from a small clay teapot into white cups, while a mallard duck stands on the table beside him. A red lantern and a round moon gate with bamboo are behind them.

taps.phrase: to kneel at the tea table
